data.exact_reserve_text:
The underwriting result was impacted by adverse developments on prior year claims estimates of GBP 98 million.
The most significant contributors were the International Financial Lines, International Casualty, Accident & Health and Wholesale Casualty offset by favorable movements on Marine, Aerospace, Crisis management and Wholesale Property. During 2020 action was taken to remediate underperforming business including the withdrawal from the International Financial Lines and Portfolio Deals.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded adverse prior-year reserve development amounting to GBP 98m (strengthening). The deterioration was driven principally by International Financial Lines, International Casualty, Accident & Health and Wholesale Casualty, partly offset by favourable movements in Marine, Aerospace, Crisis management and Wholesale Property. Separately, 2020 was materially impacted by COVID-19 (net claims GBP 523m) and a number of second-half natural catastrophe events.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development: the report explicitly states 'adverse developments on prior year claims estimates of GBP 98 million' but does not unambiguously label this amount as gross or net of reinsurance. No gross prior-year movement breakdown (insurance liabilities column) was provided in the movement note excerpt; therefore the stated GBP 98m (used above) is taken from narrative. The gross claims development triangle is present but its formatting in the extracted text prevented reliable automated diagonal extraction; hence triangle-derived PYD was not computed. LOB mappings for some internal classes (e.g. 'International Financial Lines', 'Wholesale Casualty', 'Crisis management', 'Aerospace') have been mapped to the closest standard Lloyd's categories where possible but are approximate.
